entities.name: Egyptian Mummification
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Egyptians perfected body preservation over 3,000 years. Full mummification took 70 days: organ removal (except the heart), natron drying, linen wrapping, and ritual prayers. Only the wealthy could afford it — peasants were simply buried in desert sand. The process preserved bodies for millennia.
